title: Tales of Middle-earth Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Aragorn
entities.description: Heir of the Dúnedain who bears the reforged Andúril, leads the free peoples in battle and takes up the kingship of Gondor.

entities.name: Arwen
entities.description: An Elf who watched over Aragorn from afar and made him a great and kingly standard.

entities.name: Gilraen
entities.description: A Dúnedain protector who speaks of hope in Sindarin.

entities.name: Saruman
entities.description: A Wizard of Orthanc whose works are wrapped in dark smoke and whose downfall came through the palantír.

entities.name: Gimli
entities.description: A Dwarf companion of Aragorn and Legolas who has looked on Moria and wields an axe mightily.

entities.name: Legolas
entities.description: An Elf of the Fellowship who later built a grey ship in Ithilien and sailed over Sea.

entities.name: Gandalf
entities.description: A Wizard famed in the Shire for fires, smokes, and lights, who counsels the free peoples against Sauron.

entities.name: Bilbo Baggins
entities.description: A Hobbit of the Shire fond of his garden who leaves to finish his book.

entities.name: Frodo Baggins
entities.description: A Hobbit Ring-bearer who goes to Mordor and, at the end, claims the Ring for his own.

entities.name: Samwise Gamgee
entities.description: Frodo's Hobbit companion and gardener who insists on going with him to Mordor and later restores the Shire.

entities.name: Meriadoc Brandybuck
entities.description: A Hobbit who witnessed the Huorns and wept at a green mound.

entities.name: Peregrin Took
entities.description: A Hobbit who watched the drowning of Isengard and went to Minas Tirith.

entities.name: Hamfast Gamgee
entities.description: A Hobbit recognized as the leading authority on growing vegetables, especially potatoes.

entities.name: Farmer Cotton
entities.description: A Hobbit farmer itching for trouble when the fight for the Shire begins.

entities.name: Gollum
entities.description: A creature who hates and loves the Ring as he hates and loves himself.

entities.name: Haldir
entities.description: An Elf of Lórien who brings travelers before the Lord and Lady and welcomes them to Caras Galadhon.

entities.name: Boromir
entities.description: A man of Gondor who wandered long seeking the house of Elrond.

entities.name: Elrond
entities.description: An Elf lord of Rivendell who has seen three ages in the West of the world.

entities.name: Erestor
entities.description: An Elf of the Council who says the Ring must be hidden or unmade.

entities.name: Faramir
entities.description: The last Steward of Gondor, who surrenders his office and is joined hand in hand with Éowyn.

entities.name: Éowyn
entities.description: A lady of Rohan who fell under a malady and was awakened by Aragorn.

entities.name: Théoden
entities.description: King of the Mark of Rohan who banished Wormtongue and was eulogized after death.

entities.name: Éomer
entities.description: A lord of the Mark who rejoices in the new bond between the Mark and Gondor.

entities.name: Gríma Wormtongue
entities.description: A counselor in Rohan who mocked Gandalf and was banished by Théoden.

entities.name: Háma
entities.description: A man of Rohan who returned Herugrim to Théoden from Wormtongue's room.

entities.name: Treebeard
entities.description: An Ent who opposes Orcs and their masters and hosts guests in his Ent house.

entities.name: Quickbeam
entities.description: An Ent who tells of rowan-trees planted to please the Entwives.

entities.name: Galadriel
entities.description: The Lady of Lórien who dwells in Caras Galadhon and gives hope.

entities.name: Celeborn
entities.description: The Lord who dwells in Caras Galadhon.

entities.name: Gildor
entities.description: An Elf who warns that advice is a dangerous gift.

entities.name: Radagast
entities.description: A Wizard with much lore of herbs and beasts, a master of shapes and changes of hue.

entities.name: Sauron
entities.description: The Dark Lord of Mordor who forged the One Ring in secret and whose realm is ended.

entities.name: Denethor
entities.description: Lord of Minas Tirith who hoards scrolls and believes there is no victory against the rising Power.

entities.name: Beregond
entities.description: A guard of Gondor whom Pippin begs to stop dreadful things from happening.

entities.name: Prince Imrahil
entities.description: Prince of Belfalas dwelling in Dol Amroth who stands in the place of the Steward of Gondor.

entities.name: Glóin
entities.description: A Dwarf who praises the waterways of Dale and the valor of the Beornings.

entities.name: Goldberry
entities.description: A lady who brings peace to travelers for the night.

entities.name: Ghân-buri-Ghân
entities.description: Leader of a folk granted the Forest of Drúadan forever.

entities.name: Balin
entities.description: Lord of Moria whose name is graven on a tomb slab.

entities.name: Fëanor
entities.description: A Ñoldo who may have wrought the palantíri.

entities.name: Eärendil
entities.description: The wanderer of whom the Song of Eärendil sings.

entities.name: Proudfoot
entities.description: A feasting Hobbit.

entities.name: Witch-king of Angmar
entities.description: The king of the Nine Riders whom Frodo fears at the fords.

entities.name: Nazgûl
entities.description: Servants of Sauron who cannot be easily destroyed and who wield Morgul-knives.

entities.name: Dúnedain
entities.description: A people of the North who guard the roads and drove against foes beside Gondor and Rohan.

entities.name: Rohirrim
entities.description: The horse-lords of Rohan who ride to Gondor.

entities.name: Galadhrim
entities.description: The Elves of Caras Galadhon in Lórien.

entities.name: Ents
entities.description: Earthborn tree-herds, old as mountains.

entities.name: Entwives
entities.description: Companions of the Ents for whom rowan-trees were planted.

entities.name: Huorns
entities.description: Moving trees whose business was with Orcs.

entities.name: Beornings
entities.description: Valiant Men who keep the passage from Dale to Rivendell open.

entities.name: Númenóreans
entities.description: Great mariners who yearned for the West and the immortality of the Elves.

entities.name: Ñoldor
entities.description: Elves who wrought the palantíri long ago.

entities.name: Púkel-men
entities.description: Mournful figures that loom in the dusk.

entities.name: Mûmakil
entities.description: Great beasts of Harad, like moving houses, that drag towers and engines to war.

entities.name: One Ring
entities.description: The ring Sauron forged secretly in the Mountain of Fire to master the other Rings.

entities.name: Three Rings
entities.description: Rings made for understanding, making, and healing, not war.

entities.name: Rings of Power
entities.description: Rings including the seven of the Dwarf-kings, three recovered by Sauron and the others consumed by dragons.

entities.name: Andúril
entities.description: Aragorn's sword, Narsil reforged.

entities.name: Star of Elendil
entities.description: A star worn upon Aragorn's brow.

entities.name: Herugrim
entities.description: Théoden's ancient blade, found in Wormtongue's room.

entities.name: Morgul-knife
entities.description: A weapon that would turn its victim into a wraith under the Nazgûl's command.

entities.name: Palantíri
entities.description: Seeing-stones of the Kings of Old; the name means 'that which looks far away.'

entities.name: Mirror of Galadriel
entities.description: Shows things that were, that are, and that yet may be.

entities.name: Middle-earth
entities.description: The world the Elves may soon leave forever.

entities.name: Gondor
entities.description: A realm of the South with high towers and havens.

entities.name: Rohan
entities.description: Land of the Rohirrim beyond the Great River.

entities.name: Minas Tirith
entities.description: The City of Gondor with its Citadel.

entities.name: Orthanc
entities.description: Saruman's tower.

entities.name: Isengard
entities.description: Saruman's stronghold, drowned by floods.

entities.name: Rivendell
entities.description: Elrond's perfect house where Elves dwell.

entities.name: Lothlórien
entities.description: The fairest dwelling of Legolas's people, defended against the Enemy.

entities.name: Caras Galadhon
entities.description: City of the Galadhrim in Lórien.

entities.name: The Shire
entities.description: The Hobbits' home country, despoiled and later restored.

entities.name: Mordor
entities.description: Sauron's land where the Shadows lie.

entities.name: Mount Doom
entities.description: The mountain where the One Ring was forged.

entities.name: Barad-dûr
entities.description: Sauron's tower, shaken when Frodo claimed the Ring.

entities.name: Black Gate
entities.description: Gate of Mordor hurled in ruin.

entities.name: Hornburg
entities.description: A keep never taken while men defended it.

entities.name: Moria
entities.description: Great Dwarf realm now dark and dreadful.

entities.name: Minas Morgul
entities.description: Minas Ithil, taken by evil things and made a place of dread.

entities.name: Osgiliath
entities.description: Former chief city of the Kings of Men, now deserted.

entities.name: Umbar
entities.description: A refuge for all the enemies of Gondor.

entities.name: Pelargir
entities.description: Where the main fleet of Umbar lay.

entities.name: Dol Amroth
entities.description: Prince Imrahil's castle by the sea in Belfalas.

entities.name: Weathertop
entities.description: A hill crowned by burned and broken ruins.

entities.name: Edoras
entities.description: Where the gathering of the Mark is held.

entities.name: Forest of Drúadan
entities.description: Forest granted to Ghân-buri-Ghân and his folk.

entities.name: Fangorn
entities.description: A forest whose trees seemed to march to war.

entities.name: Mirkwood
entities.description: A forest of deadly strife between Elves and evil beings.

entities.name: Ithilien
entities.description: Land of many fountains where Legolas built his ship.

entities.name: Dead Marshes
entities.description: Marshes crossed by Frodo and Sam.

entities.name: Barrow-downs
entities.description: Downs with a sinister reputation in Hobbit-legend.

entities.name: Dale
entities.description: A city of waterways, fountains and terraces.

entities.name: Eregion
entities.description: Home of the Elven-smiths betrayed by Sauron.

entities.name: Entmoot
entities.description: An assembly of the Ents.

events.summary: Aragorn declares that he and his heirs will abide in Gondor unto the ending of the world.
events.quote: "In this place will I abide, and my heirs, unto the ending of the world."

events.summary: Arwen watches over Aragorn from afar and makes him a kingly standard.
events.quote: From afar, Arwen watched over Aragorn, and in hope, she made for him a great and kingly standard.

events.summary: The Rohirrim ride to Gondor.
events.quote: "A sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises! Ride now, ride now! Ride to Gondor!"

events.summary: The realm of Sauron is proclaimed ended forever.
events.quote: "The Realm of Sauron is ended forever!"

events.summary: Faramir, last Steward of Gondor, surrenders his office.
events.quote: "The last Steward of Gondor begs leave to surrender his office."

events.summary: Aragorn goes to battle bearing Andúril and the Star of Elendil.
events.quote: Before all went Aragorn with the Flame of the West—Andúril, like a new fire kindled, Narsil reforged as deadly as of old.

events.summary: Pippin recalls watching the drowning of Isengard.
events.quote: "There we sat high up above the floods and watched the drowning of Isengard." —Pippin

events.summary: Théoden banishes Wormtongue, warning he will not be merciful again.
events.quote: "Go now, Wormtongue, whither you will. But then, if we ever meet again, I shall not be merciful." —Théoden

events.summary: The Forest of Drúadan is granted to Ghân-buri-Ghân and his folk.
events.quote: The Forest of Drúadan was granted to Ghân-buri-Ghân and his folk, to be their own forever.

events.summary: The Riders are drowned and carried away by the river.
events.quote: The Riders were overwhelmed: drowned in the roaring of the river as it carried them away.

events.summary: Gandalf tells Frodo the Nazgûl tried to pierce his heart with a Morgul-knife.
events.quote: "They tried to pierce your heart with a Morgul-knife which remains in the wound.

events.summary: Háma returns Herugrim to Théoden, found in Wormtongue's room.
events.quote: "Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade. It was found in Wormtongue's room.

events.summary: Sam plants the silver nut in the Party Field.
events.quote: Sam planted the little silver nut in the Party Field where the tree had once been, and he wondered what would come of it.

events.summary: In the Second Age, Sauron betrays the Elven-smiths of Eregion and forges the One Ring (history).
events.quote: he learned all their secrets, and betrayed them, and forged secretly in the Mountain of Fire the One Ring to be their master.

events.summary: Faramir and Éowyn are joined hand in hand.
events.quote: Faramir and Éowyn stood forth and set hand in hand; and all there drank to them and were glad.

events.summary: Frodo puts on the Ring and claims it, shaking Barad-dûr.
events.quote: As Frodo put on the Ring and claimed it for his own, the Power in Barad-dûr was shaken

events.summary: Legolas sails over Sea, reportedly with Gimli.
events.quote: Legolas built a grey ship in Ithilien, and sailed down Anduin and so over Sea; and with him, it was said, went Gimli the Dwarf.

events.summary: Sam resolves to go with Frodo to Mordor.
events.quote: "Of course you are. And I'm coming with you."

events.summary: Aragorn awakens Éowyn.
events.quote: "Éowyn Éomund's daughter, awake! For your enemy has passed away!" —Aragorn

events.summary: Gandalf smites the bridge with his staff.
events.quote: At that moment Gandalf lifted his staff, and crying aloud he smote the bridge before him.
